terra.problem: “Why Israel was exiled” explains why the exile happened; it does not describe an event that happened at Habor. The passage mentions Habor, but the moment’s text does not.
In “Eastern tribes taken to Habor,” “He brought them” could refer to God or the king. Name the king to make clear who brought them there.

“Covenant” and “stirred up the spirit of the king” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. Explain the covenant as God’s agreement with His people and use simpler wording for how God moved the king to act.
